mapper.select: SELECT mbm.memberIdx, b.ball_idx, b.ball_name, b.ball_image, b.ball_grade, b.ball_rating, b.required_match_count, b.is_active, TO_CHAR(b.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')AS created_date, TO_CHAR(b.update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')AS update_date FROM MemberBall_main mbm JOIN Ball b ON b.ball_idx = mbm.ball_idx WHERE mbm.memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
SELECT ball_idx, ball_name, ball_image, ball_grade, ball_rating, required_match_count FROM Ball WHERE required_match_count <= #{playedMatchCount} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY ball_idx
mapper.update: UPDATE MemberBall_main SET ball_idx = #{ball_idx} WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
